mapper.select: SELECT segment_id,audience_id,current_version,snapshot_sequence,enabled,next_due,lock_version FROM marketing_segment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND segment_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_segment SET current_version=#{version},enabled=FALSE,next_due=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND segment_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(d.definition_json AS CHAR) definition_json,s.audience_id,s.enabled,s.lock_version FROM marketing_segment s JOIN marketing_segment_definition d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.segment_id=s.segment_id AND d.version=s.current_version WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.segment_id=#{id}
SELECT CAST(definition_json AS CHAR) FROM marketing_segment_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND segment_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT CAST(d.definition_json AS CHAR) definition_json,s.audience_id,s.enabled,s.lock_version FROM marketing_segment s JOIN marketing_segment_definition d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.segment_id=s.segment_id AND d.version=s.current_version WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.segment_id>#{after} ORDER BY s.segment_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_segment SET enabled=#{input.enabled},next_due=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND segment_id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{input.expectedVersion}
UPDATE marketing_segment SET snapshot_sequence=snapshot_sequence+1,next_due=#{due} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND segment_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_segment_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM marketing_segment_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT FROM marketing_segment_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_segment=#{id}
SELECT FROM marketing_segment_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND segment_id=#{id} AND run_id>#{after} ORDER BY run_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.segment_id FROM marketing_segment s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.enabled=TRUE AND s.next_due<=#{now} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketing_segment_run r WHERE r.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND r.active_segment=s.segment_id) ORDER BY s.next_due,s.segment_id LIMIT 1
SELECT run_id FROM marketing_segment_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='RUNNING' AND available_at<=#{now} ORDER BY available_at,run_id LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id FROM (SELECT tenant_id FROM marketing_segment WHERE enabled=TRUE AND next_due<=#{now} UNION SELECT tenant_id FROM marketing_segment_run WHERE status='RUNNING' AND available_at<=#{now}) t WHERE tenant_id>#{after} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 4
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_segment_run SET cursor_member=#{cursor},processed=#{processed},matched=#{matched},attempts=0,error_code=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{id}
UPDATE marketing_segment_run SET status=#{status},error_code=#{error},attempts=0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{id}

UPDATE marketing_segment_run SET status=IF(attempts+1>=5,'ISOLATED','RUNNING'),attempts=attempts+1,error_code='RETRYABLE',available_at=#{due} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
